{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Gorgg Squadron''''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] of 6 [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wings]] employed by [[Nami]] [[Crime lord/Legends|Crime Lord]] [[Ali Tarrak]]. After [[Battle of Yrrna|demonstrating]] to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] the power of the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]]. Tarrak sent a [[Strike-class medium cruiser]] ''[[Nuance]]'' to arrange a trading agreement to a Rebel [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|Carrack cruiser]] [[Prism]]. Then, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] sent two [[Missile Boat]]s, one of which piloted by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], in their first [[Battle of the Eva-T system|mission]] to capture and reclaim TIE Defenders from the Rebels. '''Gorgg Squadron''' were the first T-wings to engage the starfighters and were all destroyed in the battle.
